facts.text: Quad-v0 is registered with entry point gym_rotor.envs:QuadEnv and max_episode_steps=10000
The action space is Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(4,)): four normalized motor commands
A normalized action is linearly scaled from [-1, 1] to [min_force, max_force] and clipped to that range before it becomes the four motor thrusts

The nominal quadrotor is mass 2.15 kg, arm length 0.23 m, inertia diag(0.022, 0.022, 0.035) kg m^2, torque-to-thrust coefficient 0.0135, thrust-to-weight coefficient 2.2 and standard gravity 9.81 m/s^2
Each motor thrust is bounded by min_force 0.5 N and max_force = c_tw_nominal * hover_force, with hover_force = m * g / 4
The simulation runs at 200 Hz, so one control step is dt = 1/200 s = 0.005 s
The default integrator is solve_ivp
The solve_ivp branch integrates over one dt per step with method DOP853
The state limits are x_lim 1.0 m, v_lim 4.0 m/s, W_lim 2*pi rad/s and euler_lim 85 degrees

The observation space is an 18-element Box: position x (3), velocity v (3), rotation matrix entries (9) and angular velocity W (3), with x bounded by +-x_lim, v by +-v_lim, the rotation entries by +-1 and W by +-W_lim
The state vector is (x[0:3]; v[3:6]; R_vec[6:15]; W[15:18])
QuadEnv.step returns (observation, reward, terminated, False, {})
QuadEnv.reset takes env_type, seed and options
A reset draws position, velocity and angular velocity uniformly within +-init_x, +-init_v and +-init_W and roll and pitch within +-init_R, with the attitude from rotation.from_euler('xyz')
The initial yaw is sampled uniformly from [-pi, pi]
For the default train env_type a reset uses init_x 0.6 m, init_v = v_lim*0.5 (2.0 m/s), init_R 50 degrees and init_W = W_lim*0.5 (pi rad/s), except that 20% of resets use zero for all four
The episode terminates when any position, velocity or angular velocity component reaches its limit, or the absolute roll or pitch reaches 85 degrees
The equations of motion are x_dot = v, v_dot = g*e3 - f*R@e3/m, R_vec_dot = (R@hat(W)) flattened column-major and W_dot = J^-1 * (-hat(W)@J@W + M)
The four motor thrusts map to total thrust and body moments through the matrix [1,1,1,1; 0,-d,0,d; d,0,-d,0; -c_tf,c_tf,-c_tf,c_tf]
The reward is reward_alive minus Cx*||x-xd||^2, Cv*||v-vd||^2, Cb1*|heading error| and CW*||W||^2
The reward_alive bonus is 0 and the reward_crash penalty is -1
The default reward coefficients are Cx 6.0, Cv 0.4, Cb1 6.0 and Cw12 0.6

determinism.notes: the fake draws its initial state from random.Random(seed), so one seed and one action sequence repeat a trajectory; upstream's reset uses numpy.random.uniform and random.random, which ignore the seed passed to QuadEnv.reset, so the upstream environment does not repeat a trajectory for a seed and the two do not agree

gaps: the fake re-implements the rigid-body equations of motion in pure Python with a fixed-step RK4 integrator, not scipy solve_ivp/DOP853, and was never compared with the upstream environment: trajectories can differ
no contact model: the quadrotor is a free rigid body and never lands, touches or collides with anything

ideal actuator: the four motor thrusts follow the command instantly, with no motor lag, drag or noise; upstream's uniform domain randomization of mass, arm, inertia and coefficients is not modelled (the nominal parameters only)
the fake uses Python floats and a local random.Random(seed); upstream uses numpy arrays, numpy.random.uniform and random.random, so the two do not repeat the same trajectory

the MODUL/MONO reward interpolation and the integral/error observation terms of the wrappers are not modelled; the fake returns the raw scalar reward_wrapper value (upstream's step indexes that scalar for the default MODUL framework, which raises)
no rendering (vpython) and no gymnasium wrapper: the fake does not add OrderEnforcing or TimeLimit, and it applies the registered 10000-step truncation itself
the model was never validated against a physical quadrotor

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
